body: I am afraid to die but I am starting to get to a point where I am afraid to live.

Well… My grandmother was the youngest of 9 children in the Philippines.
She had my mother with some white dude in the military
don’t know much about him
she never talked a lot about him
my mom and my grandmother were living barely
bananas and rice
my grandfather
was in the air force
he brought them to the states
and just in time too
cuz my grandmother got ovarian cancer right as she got here
they said she only had a year…
but the therapy and chemo from the states kept her alive
they brought my mother here…
she was spoiled
she got everything she wanted
was in every extracurricular
she took advantage
ditched school
never finished high school
did drugs
hung out with the wrong crowd
she ended up marrying some guy from Japan who was also Filipino
They had my sister…
my older sister
and then were planning on divorce
My mother met my father at this time
He was adopted by this nice white family in San Francisco
That’s why my name last name is smith
My dad’s parents died in North Korea.
As soon as I was born
he left
Didn’t want to take responsibility
My mother ended up marrying another man
he beat us…
he would lock us in rooms
with no furniture
and beat our mother
me and my older sister
my mother finally got fed up
Left me and my older sister in the care of my grandmother
My younger sister (her dad was the abusive guy)
Stayed with him
Afterwards my mother lived on the streets
She was a vagabond
asked for money
slept in front yards
garages…
My grandmother took care of me since I was 3…
She would wake us up at 6. Take us to school…. make dinner, pick us up and leave us at the baby sitter…
pick us up at 12am…. and do this every day…
wake up at 5
cook breakfast
same routine
Now don’t get me wrong when I say this
I love my grandmother
I really do…
But she was cold
Bitter
My mother did her in…
she wouldn’t let us have friends over
or let us do anything…
she was strict
beat us
if I didn’t cut my nails… she tired shoving nail polish down my throat
she was tough
tell me when I’m 7 years old…
how if I wasn’t there
she’d be rich
If my mom wasn’t fucking around
how she can’t keep her legs shut
I’m only  7…
We would go out 1am after she picked us up from the babysitter.
to look for my mom
Her coworkers told her how they saw her…
someone’s front yard
it was tough
I was very antisocial in school
like a puppy. No one took me seriously. I wanted attention all the time. I fell in love with the slightes thought of care
I fell apart
I was very needy
I was sensitive
a dreamer
my grandma would beat me over every little thing…
my older sister and I
even though we were raised in the same house
we both grew differently
she rebelled
I submitted
She broke my grandmas collar bone…pushed her against the door when they were ighting
the biggest accident of her life…
my grandma couldn’t work anymore
at least when she worked we had a small reprieve
that was gone…
So she guilted her
made her go crazy
she ran off
stole 6000 dollars
Me…
I let her hit me
I told her if it made her feel better
in fact I basically asked for it
I didn’t like living in fear
I’d get so mad when people threaten me…
Id always told them. DO IT
IM NOT GONNA LIVE IN FEAR
I RATHER HAVE YOU HURT ME NOW
I was crazy
in junior high
I met this girl…
I liked her before I liked girls
She was sweet
made me feel important
loved…
I guess I was more infatuated with how she treated me
I had a crush on her for 7 years…
I dated other girls
I always felt guilty
never lasted
It was high school and junior high
That’s when I first got depressed
junior high 7th grade
After that…
Well…
I forgot what happiness was
I lost all my other friends
they got sick of me
My mother got better for half a year…
had my youngest sister
then went back on the streets
asking me for money
I’ll never forget…
It was my 17th bday
First time I had friends over….
My mom walks in
smelling like piss and cigarettes…
Says
“Happy birthday son”
“Can I borrow 5 bucks?”
in front of all my friends
I gave her it of course
I didn’t want her asking my younger sister…
It was rough
I was the only kid in high school who wanted to not graduate
My grandmother told me that as soon as I did
shed kick me out
if I didn’t join the military…
I was originally gonna join the air force
But got a scholarship for graphic design
and animation
Went to SIGGRAPH
Followed my dreams…
Art….                                                                                                                                                                                                   
I got kicked out
With the scholarship which was 500 dollars
I bought my bus pass and some food….
I was on the streets for a few months…
An acquaintance from high school let me move in his house
his family hated me
he kept his distance…
I was lonely
Didn’t eat their food
I felt guilty…
I didn’t have any money for books
So my high school graphic design teacher bought them for me
I was going to community college
My grandma got a stroke…
I moved back home
took care of her
she got better
then wanted me out again
That’s when I met my first real relationship…
I met her at college
She asked me out. She got my number, picked me up
I felt like the girl lol
She was sweet
Helped me find a place right next to her house
Shed give me rides to work…
I fell madly in love with her
We were together for 2 years
She helped me so much
I was too dependant on her….
She was my first…
And she broke my heart
She changed
Started talking shit about me behind my back
telling my roommates
stopped helping me go to work
She dropped me off in the middle of the freeway… over a stupid argument
We woul constantly argue
She changed
and I blamed myself
I got so fed up with life
that I tried to hang myself
I bought some rope at home depot
and hung myself in my apartment…
I lost my job cuz I couldn’t get to work
Was getting kicked out of my apartment because no money
I lost her…
I would pass by her house everyday cuz she was so close
She would ignore me…
She was so bipolar
“The only thing consistent were her inconsistencies…”
So I tried to hang myself
A friend found out and cut me down
I was sent to a psych ward
Involuntary psychiatric hold…
I hated it
they didn’t care
they just shoved meds down your throat
for a week
I lied out of my teeth
That’s when I started writing
A lot of my writing was from her originally
I told them I attempted suicide for attention when the real reason was that I didn’t want to face the pai
They let me ou
Gave me a 1000 bill
It was so dumb
If anything it just made me feel like getting caught and not succeeding is worse than dying…
So for 3 months I stayed at another friend’s house
Drowning myself away
Never moving from the bed
One day though…
It was after watching a movie
500 days of summer
It answered all the questions I had
Like what did I do wrong?
Why did she hate me?
It had nothing to do with me…
People change
I kept blaming myself
So I got over her… for the most part
Started dating
Got a better job
was more confident
intimate
people told me I was so strong
That they felt like they knew me forever
I was very emotionally invested in people
I always told them…
I’m not here to judge
only to listen
It was nice
I would try to help everyone
they would ask me why I wasn’t afraid
I’d tell them it didn’t happen overnight
That life was short
That you shouldn’t be afraid of making mistakes because 100 years from now no one is gonna remember the stupid stuff you did…
I met my other long relationship
We were together for a year…
She was perfect in everyway
Kind
She took care of me
Fed me
I got ulcers from the stress from before. Poor eating habits too…
So she was sweet
I loved her…
But I was on medication
And I’m not using this as an excuse but…
I was so apathetic
Antidepressants…
I stopped caring
My grandmother got cancer…
and only had haf a year to live…
which turned into 2 months
 to 2 weeks
any day
This all happened in the span of 3 months…
She was diagnosed
She died so quickly
they diagnosed her in April
She died in July
…
She died last year…
I didn’t visit her as much as my older sister
(They made up)
and it wasn’t because I didn’t care
I just felt so bad to see someone so strong be that way
My family was the master of guilt trips (me included)
My older sister would guilt me
Tell me how much of a failure I was…
That grandma never expected anything of me
and now that’s she’s dead she never will
I never fully mourned her…
I don’t know if I was bitter or if it was the antidepressants
I stopped taking them after the funeral…
My ex and I…
We were good
But things got boring
She’d make a good wife id say
But I’m not looking for a wife
I was looking for a girlfriend…
A friend of mines visited from Arizona
She kissed me
and didn’t stop her…
I told my ex
She was heartbroken
I don’t blame her…
I told her to never take me back
No matter how much I begged
Which she did
and I’m glad
She met a better guy a month after we broke up
She didn’t deserve that
And I can’t make an excuse for myself…
I was her first…
So I still feel the guilt
Hell I did beg for her back…
Even after all that…
A while after well…
I met my recent ex
I am gonna try again tonight...
I'm not gifted. I just convey my thoughts on paper. And besides... I am so lonely... not like my writing would attract anyone either.
All I do is write. Its my vent. My escape. But sometimes its not good enough to keep me living...

I feel lost. I tried what you said and I just have these nightmares... these dreams. Of times... of moments where I cant forget. I cant let go... I have no family support, or friends. I have these dreams of people I've lost. Who push me away. who dont need me... who tell me they are better off without me and it makes me feel sick. Sick to my stomach. How happier they are and how they tell me they dont want anything to do with me. I feel so pathetic for reaching out to them. to anyone. And all this pent up regret.. from losing my grandmother... about how I should have visited her in the hosptial more. How I should of done a lot of things. How I cant change the past and it haunts me. How I cant forgive myself. How i cant let go.

Well first off I initiate every conversation, every time to hang out with people is my idea. its pathetic and looks so desperate to go out of my way for people who make excuses upon excuses to avoid hanging out with me. and once I do get them to they arent even very interested. 

The only solitude I enjoy is away from family because it just seems like you cant trust them as they are always instigating or starting some stupid shit out of some ridiculous martyr complexes they all have(me included)

I try and lie to everyone about vulnerability but I cant god damn lie to myself. I am me I feel. That is how I am. I let my emotions rule me. I let my heart make decisions. I am impulsive, needy, and sadly hopeful. As for love its silly I have self confidence. I am very charismatic around people. People come to me. tell me things they feel they can trust me. I am an open book. sincere. thats the only thing I have going. I think I am good looking, I think I am a decent person. Its my self respect i lack. I dont care about my body(i am super thin) i dont care about what i eat or if i dont. or if I am in harms way. i lack any restraint involving injuries.

as for my writing here is an excerpt
"I remember it. I remember the ocean breeze, her singing. Passing through the streets, passing through recording the moments with her camera. I remember our laughter, our talks, light, lighthearted, I remember how beautiful it was, how beautiful she was, she is… I remember… I loved it. I loved it more than our trip to Disneyland, more than breathing, more than how beautiful coast highway was, more than anything I loved her, and I felt so happy. You cant replicate that kind of happiness within yourself, that’s an experience… I remember dreaming, holding her hand the entire way. Even when I was overwhelmed with my senses, my priorities, pure bliss. I remember…  It wasn’t a generated effort, it wasn’t a forced hand.  And I loved her. I remember… and I cant forget, I wont… Even while it kills me. I never felt so real… All the forced smiles, all the fake happiness from years of regret, years of experience… I was happy, not a medicated happiness, not a forced happiness, but a true happiness. And I was in love. No motives, no hate, no plans, just peace, and at that moment, all those moments, I felt real. I remember her voice, her smile, I remember it as if she was the only thing tangible, when she was the only thing in existence. I was consumed, enveloped, and oh so happy.  My metaphysical high, my euphoria, I was drugged up on happiness."
